headline: US Dollar Climbs Further in Colombian Foreign Exchange Market
summary: The price of the US dollar in Colombia continued to rise, trading well above 3,600 pesos amid market volatility and exchange rate fluctuations.
why: Currency exchange rate movements affect import costs, foreign debt servicing, and domestic inflationary pressures in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: US Dollar / Colombian Peso
impacts.why: Foreign exchange market volatility alters cross-border purchasing power.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
